law: Path laws constrain or score an authored TRACE. They do not assert physical adjacency, accessibility, human behavior, or Home Assistant truth.

source_donor.adaptation: laws act on ordered HOUSE addresses rather than cellular update physics

specimens.label: NO ECHO
specimens.rule: Forbid A → B → A immediate return.

specimens.label: ONE STROKE
specimens.rule: A directed segment may be traversed at most once.
specimens.test: Every ordered pair nodes[i-1]→nodes[i] is unique.

specimens.label: PILGRIM
specimens.rule: Visit each addressed room at most once.

specimens.label: HOME
specimens.rule: After leaving, finish at the starting address.
specimens.test: With >=3 nodes, last address equals first address.

specimens.label: FIVE GATES
specimens.rule: Visit at least five distinct addresses and return home.

composition.meaning: Every enabled specimen must pass for the path program to PASS.

stop_condition: Do not add geometry/adjacency laws until the current physical house graph is verified or the law is explicitly labeled as a donor-topology game.
